topic: Beta release and production approval status
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on the deployment status of a feature. Initial messages confirmed plans to release to beta and obtain approval for production rollout from Brazil. A participant noted that charts were fixed, but social classes were not yet available. Later, confirmation was given that the release had occurred, followed by a clarification regarding whether the current state was still in beta.
decisions: The feature is scheduled to be released to beta.
Production approval from Brazil is required for full rollout.
